description: Checks each AI agent tool call against a policy before it runs (allow, deny, or hold for a person's approval), signs every call and decision into a hash chain, and exports each run as a .tkb file that verifies offline. Python package tracekit-ai, TypeScript package @cygnuxlabs/tracekit.
rules: Install the Python package as tracekit-ai (pip install tracekit-ai); the package named tracekit on PyPI is an unrelated project. The npm package is @cygnuxlabs/tracekit.
Fastest start: put import tracekit; tracekit.instrument() on the first line of the agent, run it, then run tracekit last to export and verify the latest run.
Framework integrations live in tracekit.integrations.<framework>, for example tracekit.integrations.langchain.TracekitMiddleware; each has a guide in docs/integrations/ or docs/quickstarts/.
A denied call returns the reason to the model as the tool result and the run goes on; a held call waits until a person runs tracekit approvals approve <id>.
Dev mode runs the signer as the agent's own user and does not protect the record from that agent; for tamper resistance run the signer as another user, in a container or on another host.
Python 3.9 or newer for the core; most framework integrations need Python 3.10 or newer, and Pydantic AI, Google ADK and Haystack need 3.11. The TypeScript SDK needs Node 18 or newer.
